sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by quantum-dot labeling of fixed cells (L2/L3) and by anti-HA antibody labeling of live non-permeabilized cells (L4); channel function NOT MEASURED in these reports.
sites.rationale: L2 explicitly states the HA tag is located in the extracellular part of each ORAI1 subunit in the hexameric channel, and L3 confirms surface display by quantum-dot labeling of the full-length membrane-anchored protein. L4 independently corroborates an HA tag on the extracellular face of full-length Orai1 via antibody labeling of non-permeabilized cells. ORAI1 has two extracellular loops (ECL1: 106–119, ECL2: 197–233) and no extracellular terminus; neither the L2/L3 nor the L4 clip names a specific residue or loop, so the junction cannot be pinned and insert_after_residue is left null. The site is reported at region level only. Full-length membrane-anchored ORAI1 with an HA tag inserted into the extracellular portion of the protein, expressed in cells and labeled with quantum dots (PMC7831003, L2/L3) and independently confirmed by anti-HA antibody labeling of non-permeabilized cells expressing YFP-HA-Orai1 (PMC10501913, L4).

sources.claim: The HA-tag is located in the extracellular part of each of the six ORAI1 proteins constituting the hexameric ORAI1 channel.

literature_notes: L1 (PMC13554433) describes Myc-tagged ORAI1 constructs carrying K204A and I229A point mutations, but the Myc tag insertion position is never stated in the clip; this fails the 'tag position unstated' disqualification rule and was not promoted to a site. L5 (PMC8657799) describes V5-Orai1 whose topology was characterised by antibody labelling; the 'V5-Orai1' naming convention places V5 at the protein N-terminus, which falls in the intracellular span (residues 1–91 per the authoritative topology landmarks), so this is recorded in other_positions as an intracellular tag. ORAI1 has no extracellular terminus (both N- and C-termini are intracellular), so topology_derived position assignment is not applicable. The single qualifying site (HA in the extracellular loop) cannot be resolved to a specific residue or even to a specific loop (ECL1 vs ECL2) from the ledger evidence alone.

literature_other_positions.note: V5-Orai1 places the V5 epitope at the protein N-terminus (residue 1), which lies in the intracellular span (residues 1–91); topology was confirmed by antibody labelling in the cited study, making this a validated intracellular tag position, not a surface site.
